suggestions: I'm grateful for the deploy going out clean on a Friday afternoon, no rollback needed, no pings after.
I'm thankful for the teh tarik stall still being open when I finally left the office past nine.
I'm grateful for catching that off-by-one error in staging instead of hearing about it from a user first.
I'm thankful for the rain cooling things down right as I stepped out for lunch.
I'm grateful for waking up before the alarm and getting a few quiet minutes to myself before Fajr.
I'm thankful for my manager actually reading the doc before the meeting instead of making me re-explain everything.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a paycheck that cleared on time, no scrambling to cover rent this month.
I'm thankful for my mum's voice note nagging me to eat properly, even when I only half listen.
I'm grateful for a flaky test that turned out to be a real race condition and not just noise.
I'm thankful for the kopitiam not running out of roti canai before I got there for once.
I'm grateful for a long drive back to Johor with a good playlist and no jam for a change.
I'm thankful for a stranger holding the lift door at the LRT station when my hands were full of groceries.
I'm grateful for finally understanding a part of the codebase I'd been too scared to touch for months.
I'm thankful for the small talk with the pakcik after Friday prayers that somehow makes the week feel lighter.
I'm grateful for a weekend where nothing broke in production and I actually got to switch off.
